answer: Cosignatures are collected in atlas, verified in pulse, and relic names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 27 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Scaling to 144 identities multiplies that fee by 123 with no matching gain in influence. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
